description: During session wrap, surfaced Brackney and Cresta follow-ups as open loops without first checking sent items to verify whether David had already sent those emails. Both had been sent. This is a failure of the check-before-surfacing protocol — open loops should be verified against live data before presenting them as outstanding.
correction: Before flagging any email-related open loop at session close, check sent items via M365 MCP to confirm status. Do not surface as pending what can be verified as done.
systemic_fix: Session wrap open-loop surfacing must include a sent-items check for any email draft flagged as unsent during the session.
